h:
1.0版本

我的 ComfyUI 工作流程的第一个版本，用于 txt2img 和升级。此版本包括三种不同的高档变体供您尝试。我个人最喜欢的仍然是 Ultimate SD Upscale，但其他都是值得尝试的竞争者。我为 Dev 版本做了这个，也许 Schnell 也可以对设置进行一些调整。确保使用 ComfyUI Manager 获取所有丢失的节点。请随意留下一些反馈或想法来改进它。

o.en:
Version 1.0

The first release of my ComfyUI workflow for txt2img and upscaling. This Version includes three different upscale variants for you to try out. My personal favorite still is Ultimate SD Upscale but the others are contenders worth trying. I made this for the Dev version, maybe Schnell also works with some adjustments to the settings. Make sure to use the ComfyUI Manager to get all the missing nodes. Feel free to leave some feedback or ideas to improve it.
